cohort: Patients who underwent emergency obstetric hysterectomy (EOH) in Gynae unit 111 of Services Hospital Lahore from October 1, 2013, to September 30, 2016.
finding: The most common indication for EOH has shifted from uterine atony to placenta accreta, likely due to the rising cesarean section rate.
followup_time: The mean hospital stay was 7 days.
